title: AssertionError: assert isinstance(reinferred_rvalue_type, TupleType) in check_multi_assignment_from_tuple
body:
With the testfile: test.py
```
TEST = {'key': ('a', 'b')}
def test():
    # type: () -> None
    a, b = TEST.get('foo', ('x', 'y'))
```

And mypy 0.521 installed via Homebrew on OSX.

With the command: `mypy --py2 --show-traceback test.py`
